Orders Table for an e-commerce admin in React

Orders Table is the orders index of a store admin. Each order shows its number, a relative date with the exact time on hover, the customer, channel, total, payment and fulfillment status, item count, delivery method and tags. Payment and fulfillment are separate pills, and each has a progress glyph (an empty, half or full circle) so Partially paid or Partially fulfilled reads without relying on color.

Saved views in tab order. Pair with onViewsChange to persist custom views.

Saved views sit in tabs: All, Unfulfilled, Unpaid, Open, Archived and your own. A view is a set of filters, a sort and a search. Change any of them and the tab is marked Modified, with Reset, Update view and Save as new view. Filter chips cover status, payment, fulfillment, date, channel, tag and risk. ordersQueryToSearchParams and ordersQueryFromSearchParams keep the whole query in the URL, so a link opens the same list and Back works.
Selected order ids. With allMatching in client mode, every matching id.

Selection works like a desktop list. Shift-click selects a range, the header checkbox selects the page, then Select all 48 orders selects every match. The bulk bar takes the header’s place, so nothing shifts. Mark as fulfilled, Capture payment (with a confirmation showing the amount), Add tags, Archive and Print packing slips are async. Partial failures name the orders that failed with a View link, and Archive can be undone. J and K move a focus ring, X selects, Enter opens, / searches and Esc clears.

onBulkAction gets the action and the selection, either explicit ids or allMatching with the query. Return the ids that failed with a short reason and the table reports “Fulfilled 5 orders. 1 couldn’t be fulfilled: #1031 is on hold” with a View link.

toShopifySearch turns the view, filters and search into an orders(query:) string, and toShopifyVariables adds the sort key and page size. Archived maps to status:closed, and partial states map to Shopify’s financial and fulfillment filters.
